entries.title: Crewmates can run on your Google AI plan through Antigravity
entries.body: If Google's Antigravity is installed on your computer, Settings → Intelligence offers it as a new subscription for crewmates. Before you sign in, Infinitary shows what Google's terms and forum say about using Antigravity this way. Signing in uses Antigravity's own Google sign-in, and Infinitary never sees your password or tokens. Crewmates use the Gemini models in your plan. Your remaining allowance is read when you sign in, open Settings → Intelligence or press Recheck allowance.

picture.alt: The Antigravity sign-in in Settings shows what Google's terms say, with Sign in with Google and Not now
